full_details: In the morning the joins were still marks, here a messenger and here York, angry, and the line was still in the margin of the speech you did not copy out. The pen stayed capped. In the afternoon the house played The Two Gentlemen at two. You were not in it. You were at the board. The parliament sheet stayed blank. At the reckoning Heminges shut the bag and named twelve shillings the share. Last Saturday he had not shut it, and had not named one. The twenty-fourth of May had been thirty-six. You did not add the twelve to a coffer, and you did not send money home. At night you kept Sunday at Field's table and the Holinshed in the house.
one_sentence: You stayed at the board through Two Gentlemen, and took twelve shillings at the reckoning, with the bag shut.
title: Twelve shillings, and the bag shut
